suggested_requirements.text: The Clarus system shall implement quality checking processes as soon as data become available.
The CAS shall be able to configure schedules for executing QChS.
The Clarus system shall record the methods applied when deriving quality checking information.
The CAS shall record the quality checking methods used.
The Clarus system shall be able to implement quality checking rules for each environmental parameter.
The CAS shall be able to configure the quality checking rules for each environmental parameter.
The CAS shall enable administrators to manage quality checking rules.
The Clarus system shall be able to implement quality checking rules for specific environmental situations.
The CAS shall be able to configure quality checking rules for specific environmental situations.
The Clarus system shall be able to implement quality checking rules specific to observation locations.
The CAS shall be able to configure quality checking rules specific to observation locations.
The Clarus system shall be able to base its quality checking process on historical environmental data.
The CAS shall be able to configure historical environmental data to be used by quality checking processes.
The Clarus system shall be able to use multiple algorithms for its quality checking process.
The CAS shall be able to configure multiple algorithms to be used in the quality checking process.
The Clarus system shall allow access to new surface transportation-related environmental data.
The CAS shall be configurable to allow new observation types to be implemented as they become available.
The Clarus system shall enable administrators to manage security groups.
The CAS system shall enable administrators to manage security group members.
The CAS shall have an administrator security group.
The CAS shall have a quality manager security group.
The Clarus system shall be able to restrict environmental data publication based on source.
The CAS shall be able to record data sharing restrictions.
The Clarus system shall record statistics about its operation.
The CAS shall record statistics about the system operation.
The Clarus system shall log data transactions.
The CAS shall log data transactions.
The Clarus system shall acquire, process, and disseminate environmental metadata.
The CAS shall manage contributor metadata.
The CAS shall manage collector metadata.
The CAS shall manage quality checking schedules.
The CAS shall manage environmental data collection schedules.
The CAS shall manage ESS metadata.
The Clarus system shall manage environmental data and metadata according to the Clarus data sharing agreements.
The CAS shall manage data sharing rules based on contributor data sharing agreements.
The Clarus system shall collect, quality check, and disseminate environmental data.
The CAUI shall be able to initiate CS on demand.
The Clarus system shall provide environmental data quality flags.
The CAUI shall enable a quality manager to apply manual flags to a set of observations from an individual ESS.
The CAUI shall enable a quality manager to apply manual flags to a set of observations.
